table.raw_source:
;specialattacks
20,
1,The dragon has claws of sharpness. They will sever limbs on a natural roll of 20.
1,The dragon can charm with his voice. Anyone hearing it must save or protect the dragon.
1,The dragon has a sticky tongue and attacks as a cave fisher.
1,The dragon has tail spines like a manticore
1,The dragon's gaze changes the nature of creatures that look within its eyes. It acts as a reverse alignment.
1,The dragon can spray caustic urine causing 2d6 damage and painful blistering until a first aid check is made.
1,The dragon's wings have bony serrations. It slashes for 1d8 damage at targets far away.
1,The dragon's tail ends in a bone club. When smashed against the ground it shatters, hurling shrapnel in a 30' radius. doing 1d6 damage.

entries.text: The dragon can only be struck by magic weapons.
entries.raw_text: 1,The dragon can only be struck by magic weapons.

entries.text: The dragon exudes an anti-magic field in a 5' radius.

entries.text: The dragon's skin is like that as a chameleon. It is 90% undetectable when still.
entries.raw_text: 1,The dragon's skin is like that as a chameleon. It is 90% undetectable when still.

entries.text: The dragon sheds scales that act as caltrops constantly.

entries.text: The dragon is enveloped in an aura of fire. It does 1d4 damage per round to those engaged in melee with the dragon.
entries.raw_text: 1,The dragon is enveloped in an aura of fire. It does 1d4 damage per round to those engaged in melee with the dragon.

entries.text: The dragon is surrounded by a miasmal fog, anyone who engaged in melee must save to avoid becoming sickened.

entries.text: The dragon regenerates 3 hit points a round.
